projects.title: GMG Print Workflow SaaS Platform
projects.description: Senior engineer on GMG's multi-tenant SaaS product for professional print hardware, working in a SAFe Agile team. My ongoing work covers the security and identity layer (REST APIs with OAuth2, JWT, and fine-grained tenant permissions using Authzed), the IPC layer between the software and the printers (Named Pipes and sockets), CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps with Docker, automated tests including Cypress E2E, and React and TypeScript features in the frontend.

projects.title: .NET Framework to .NET 8 Migration
projects.description: Helped make the decision to move the product from .NET Framework to .NET 8, then led the migration work, including moving local storage from SQL CE to SQLite. The codebase is large and commercial, so the work was done step by step while the product stayed in production.

projects.title: OSS Licence Compliance Automation
projects.description: Designed and built a tool on my own that checks open-source licences for 3 applications and all their transitive dependencies (57+ NuGet packages in the main app). It checks each package against the approved licence policy, generates the copyright notices, acknowledgement file, and SBOM, and runs in the CI pipeline so an unreviewed package cannot ship. Manual legal review is no longer needed.

projects.title: MCP Server for AI-Assisted Development
projects.description: Built an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server in Python that gives LLM tools search over a RAG index of the codebase. Engineers use it to find their way around the legacy code, and it made onboarding new people to the platform much faster.

projects.title: Enterprise Analytics & Regulatory Reporting Platform
projects.description: Sole architect and technical lead of a BI and regulatory reporting platform (React.js, Node.js, Docker, microservices) that brought together transaction data from Postbank of Iran's core banking system, 400+ branches, ATMs, and POS network. I added an API layer for external BI tools and a React Native app for branch-level reports. Senior management used it daily, and its reports went directly to the Central Bank.

projects.title: Banking ETL & Regulatory Data Pipelines
projects.description: Designed Node.js and SQL Server ETL pipelines that processed high volumes of transaction data from several banking systems at PBI. Mistakes in Central Bank submissions had legal and financial consequences, so the pipelines enforced strict validation rules.

projects.title: Amitis Hamta FinTech Platform
projects.description: Freelance architecture consultant for Amitis Hamta Co. alongside my full-time role. Advised on the full-stack architecture and built a secure payment panel integration, covering API design and payment flows.

projects.title: Shetab National Card Network Integration
projects.description: Led R&D and design for PBI's integration with Shetab, Iran's national card network. Built high-availability Java services that process national card payments in real time.

projects.title: Chakavak National Cheque-Clearing Backbone
projects.description: Designed the IBM MQ messaging layer for PBI's part of Chakavak, the national cheque-clearing system. Messages are processed asynchronously across distributed nodes and survive node failures, within the Central Bank's SLAs.

projects.title: Core Banking Platform
projects.description: Designed and delivered a full core banking platform in .NET and C#, covering Accounting, Treasury, HR, Branch Operations, and Supervisor workflows. It ran on a 15-node SQL Server cluster and served 15,000 concurrent users with ACID transactional isolation.

projects.title: POS Terminal & ATM Integration Software
projects.description: Developed C++ POS terminal software that talks to the hardware at protocol level, plus ATM and card-processing modules with real-time authorisation and settlement at PBI.
